main.description: Verify an EIP-4361 SIWE message, then link the proven Ethereum EOA or ERC-1271 smart-account address to the caller's ERC725 root identity. Caller must already hold a valid session (passkey-first policy, ADR-0074) that resolves to an ERC725 root identity. EOA signatures are verified by ERC-191 recovery; Coinbase Smart Wallet / contract-account signatures are verified with ERC-1271 isValidSignature. On success, persists `provider='coinbase-smart-wallet'` for smart accounts or `provider='ethereum'` for plain EOA under the ERC725 root DID, recomputes actor.score, and emits the corresponding did:pkh:eip155:<chainId>:<address> wallet alias.

message.description: Exact SIWE message returned by linkEthereumBegin

signature.description: 0x-prefixed signature produced by personal_sign. EOA signatures are normally 65-byte r||s||v; ERC-1271 smart-account signatures may be contract-defined.

address.description: Lowercase 0x-prefixed Ethereum address that was recovered + verified

errors.name: InvalidSignature
errors.description: Signature does not recover to the address claimed in the SIWE message and ERC-1271 validation failed

errors.name: InvalidNonce
errors.description: Nonce is missing, expired, or not bound to the caller's ERC725 root DID

errors.name: RootIdentityRequired
errors.description: Caller is still on an unmigrated legacy DID with no ERC725 root facade link

errors.name: InvalidChainId
errors.description: Chain ID in SIWE message does not match server configuration
